panels.description: Per assignee, counts issues created in the window split by status into To Do, In Progress and Done.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(i.assignee_name, '(Unassigned)') as Developer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'TODO'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `To Do`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `In Progress`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Done
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter( i.created_date ) 
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
GROUP BY Developer
ORDER BY (`To Do` + `In Progress` + Done) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Tickets By Status

panels.description: Counts issues currently in progress status per assignee.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.assignee_name as Developer, COUNT(i.id) as `Work In Progress`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ) 
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
GROUP BY assignee_name
ORDER BY `Work In Progress` DESC

panels.title: Current Work in Progress

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(i.resolution_date, ${interval})                     AS time,
  COUNT(*) as Value
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND i.status LIKE 'DONE'
  AND i.assignee_id IN ($developer_id)
  AND i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) 
  AND i.type NOT LIKE 'EPIC'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT COALESCE(assignee_name, '(Unassigned)') as Developer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'BUG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Bugs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'STORY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Stories,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'TASK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as Tasks,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'SUBTASK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `Sub Tasks`,
  COUNT(i.id) as Total
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id like 'jira:%'
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id )
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  )
GROUP BY Developer
ORDER BY Developer;

list.definition:
select DISTINCT upm.project_name
from user_project_mapping upm 
join project_mapping pm ON upm.project_name = pm.project_name 
WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id like 'jira:%'
and upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY upm.project_name

list.definition:
SELECT CONCAT(b.name, '--', b.id) AS text
FROM project_mapping pm
JOIN boards b ON b.id = pm.row_id
WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.row_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND pm.project_name IN ( $project )
ORDER BY text

list.definition:
WITH scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  SELECT ia.assignee_id AS account_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.creator_id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.creator_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT ic.author_id
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT w.author_id
  FROM issue_worklogs w
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = w.issue_id
  WHERE w.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name;
